args.prompt: They sway together on the beat. One unified warm frame: FAST and SLOW shoulder to shoulder, arms over each other's shoulders, chanting with the crowd, sunrise flare behind them. Camera: Medium two-shot, straight on. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, warm golden sunrise light, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
